gaps.explanation: Debt Service and Capital Projects columns (p4) are already in detail (pass 1). The rest is the budgetary (cash) basis of the pp8-12 schedules vs the p4 modified-accrual fund columns, reconciled on p13 ('To adjust revenues for receivables, unearned revenues and deferred inflows'). Per fund, p4 Total revenues vs schedule Actual Total revenues: General 53,795,248 vs 33,952,654 (p8) = 19,842,594; ARPA 3,665,234 vs 42,118 (p9) = 3,623,116 (= p13 ARPA adjustment; the p4 ARPA Federal grants 3,623,116 is not a budget-basis receipt); Keno Lottery 1,044,278 vs 1,000,537 (p10) = 43,741 (= p13); Papillion Landing 2,498,982 vs 2,494,566 (p11) = 4,416 (= p13); Papio Bay 335,048 vs 335,062 (p12) = -14. Sum 23,513,853 = gap. The General difference 19,842,594 + 495,134 (sale of capital assets, a revenue row on p8 but other financing on p4) + 207,007 (subscription financing, p4 other financing) = 20,544,735 = p13 General revenue adjustment. Closing it would need GAAP-column lines on top of complete budget-basis schedules (e.g. General 'Taxes - city sales' 19,264,832 alone would not tie either), i.e. mixing bases. No line missing; no fix.

Debt Service and Capital Projects columns are already in detail. Remaining: p4 Total expenditures vs budget-schedule Actual: General 40,656,763 vs 39,426,604 (p8) = 1,230,159 (= p13 expenditure adjustment (1,230,159); includes the p4 General lease/subscription rows 23,797 + 4,039 + 92,364 + 5,671 that the cash-basis schedule does not print); Keno Lottery 283,855 vs 339,148 (p10) = -55,293 (= p13); Papillion Landing 2,937,927 vs 2,955,100 (p11) = -17,173 (= p13); Papio Bay 495,431 vs 501,001 (p12) = -5,570 (p13 5,556 net of the -14 revenue difference). Sum 1,152,123 = gap. Printed basis difference; no fix.

All p4 other-financing rows of every fund column are in detail: Capital Projects Issuance of debt 8,940,000, Premium on bonds 251,162, Original issue discount (93,589); General Subscription financing 207,007 (pass 2); all transfers. Non-transfer other-financing detail = 8,940,000 + 251,162 - 93,589 + 207,007 = 9,304,580. JSON debt_proceeds 8,940,000 + other_financing 859,714 = 9,799,714; the difference 495,134 is p4 General 'Proceeds from sale of capital assets', which is already in detail as a revenue row (detail index 14, printed among revenues on the p8 General budget schedule) - same money, not added again. The schedule_total 9,191,162 = issuance 8,940,000 + premium 251,162, while the JSON statement puts the premium in other_financing: classification only. Nothing missing.
